text:
Trump's move appeared to "disgust" Brigitte Macron (stock image)(Image: Anna Moneymaker, Getty Images)

The President of the United States has been accused of making yet another "creepy move" toward Brigitte Macron during his trip to France. This week Donald Trump has joined world leaders in France for the G7 Summit.

As part of his visit, he was invited to dinner by France's President Emmanuel Macron, held at the gilded Palace of Versailles. However, following the dinner, Trump was filmed making what has been characterized as a questionable gesture toward Macron's wife, Brigitte Macron.

It's not the first time the President has caught people's attention this week either. The alleged incident follows a lip reader's interpretation of a revealing remark Trump seems to have made earlier this week.

A social media user, identified as Acyn on X, highlighted a specific moment that generated significant discussion. Accompanying a video of Trump departing the dinner, he posted: "President Trump pulls in Brigitte Macron to kiss her."

In the footage, the French President embraces Trump before his departure. Brigitte then moves forward and they share two kisses on each cheek, but what happens next left viewers stunned.

After a momentary pause, the U.S. President appears to direct his lips toward her and lean in for another kiss while placing his hand on her shoulder. Brigitte seems to pull back and the encounter ends.

The clip sparked widespread conversation, with viewers offering various interpretations. Many believed she appeared somewhat uneasy.

One commented: "Look at her body language. She doesn't want to be anywhere near him!"

Another said: "The step back when he touched her again. I bet she threw up after."

A third responded: "I'm sure she was horrified! He tried again and she pulled away. They probably thought 'thank God he's gone'."

A fourth also weighed in: "Her body language clearly says she is uncomfortable, especially the point where he leans closer and she moves back. Creepy Don."

Yet, another observer noted: "I could see Brigette Macron recoil in disgust!" However, not all those watching felt his conduct was out of line.

One user stated: "I hate Trump, but he doesn't pull her. That's standard for a hello and a goodbye." While another suggested: "No, he grabbed her for stability."

This follows earlier reports this week of the President's alleged "creepy behavior", during which onlookers similarly noticed him appearing to maintain a firm grip on her hand.
